_note: What kind of leader voters want. Every group wants a mix of these. A group's wish for a type = base + 'by' (its age, class, region or nationality) + 'lean' (it leans that way on an issue: 'order:L' = Authority, beyond 25) + 'disaffected' x how fed up it is + 'pull' x how much it votes on personality. 'climate' raises the wish while the country is in that state: crisis (the major crisis), war (a neighbour is hot), hard_times (jobs or prices are bad), distrust (trust in politics is low). How well a leader fits each type is worked out in sim.gd (leader_fit) from their style, record and positions. label: a noun phrase; want: how a group's wish reads in the Electorate file.

TYPES.label: A revolutionary
TYPES.want: someone to tear the system down

TYPES.label: Clean hands
TYPES.want: someone untouched by the old politics

TYPES.label: An expert
TYPES.want: someone who knows how things work
